name: Calendar date
definition: One row per calendar date in the study.

name: Study week
definition: Week with the most receipts that day. The cutover is early morning, so a date can touch two weeks.

name: Study week number
definition: The week printed on the receipt, 1 to 53. Not an ISO week.

name: Partial week
definition: True when the week covers fewer than 6 dates. Week 1 is partial.

name: Department
definition: Top of the product hierarchy.

name: Category
definition: Commodity. The worked example lives at this grain.

name: Fuel flag
definition: Gasoline quantity is scaled and is excluded from grocery unit totals.

name: Demographics present
definition: Only a subset of households have age and income bins.

name: Campaign type
definition: Type A, B, or C as labeled by the study. I treat the household list as the mailed group for every type.

name: Net sales
definition: Cash the retailer received. Already net of the three discounts.

name: Gross sales proxy
definition: sales_value + retail_discount + coupon_discount + match_discount.

name: Discount cost
definition: Sum of the three discount fields, stored as positive costs.

name: Grocery units
definition: Quantity, with fuel lines set to 0.

name: On feature
definition: The product-store-week appears in the promotions file (display or mailer).

name: Incremental net sales
definition: Difference-in-differences on household weekly net sales, times treated households, times campaign weeks.

name: Promo ROI proxy
definition: incremental_sales / coupon and match discounts on couponed products for mailed households.

name: Redemption rate
definition: Redemptions / (mailed households × distinct coupon UPCs).

name: Feature lift
definition: Feature-week sales / baseline-week sales − 1, weighted by dollars, on pairs with enough history.

name: Forecast MAPE
definition: Sum of absolute errors / sum of actual net sales on the holdout.

name: Promo-sensitive share
definition: Households whose discount share of the pre-discount ring is at least 18%, with 8 or more baskets.
